identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Interleukin-6 Receptor Inhibitor Combined With Endovascular Treatment in Patients With Acute Anterior Circulation Large Vessel Occlusion Stroke -2
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Interleukin-6 Receptor Inhibitor Combined With Endovascular Treatment in Patients With Acute Anterior Circulation Large Vessel Occlusion Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Clinical Trial-2 (IRIS-2)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial. Investigators aim to assess the efficacy and safety of interleukin-6 receptor inhibitor combined with endovascular treatment in patients with acute anterior circulation large vessel occlusion stroke.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The study population are patients with acute anterior circulation large vessel occlusion stroke and planned to undergo endovascular treatment. All participants are randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to the tocilizumab group or the placebo group. In tocilizumab group, participants will receive tocilizumab combined endovascular treatment. And in placebo group, participants will receive placebo combined endovascular treatment. All participants will be visited immediately postoperatively, at 24 hours, 7 days, and 90 days after randomization.

armGroups.label: Tocilizumab group
armGroups.description: Endovascular treatment combined 240 mg tocilizumab injection once.

armGroups.label: Placebo group
armGroups.description: Endovascular treatment combined equivalent volume of placebo once.

interventions.name: Tocilizumab
interventions.description: 240 mg of tocilizumab injection will be diluted in 0.9% NaCl solution to prepare a total solution volume of 100 mL. The solution will be administered via intravenous infusion immediately after randomization, and no later than 30 minutes, with an infusion duration of more than 1 hour.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: An equivalent volume of placebo will be diluted in 0.9% NaCl solution to prepare a total solution volume of 100 mL. The solution will be administered via intravenous infusion immediately after randomization, and no later than 30 minutes, with an infusion duration of more than 1 hour.

primaryOutcomes.measure: modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score at 90 days
primaryOutcomes.description: The mRS ranges from 0 to 6, with higher scores indicating worse outcomes.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of patients with mRS score 0-2 at 90 days
Proportion of patients with mRS score 0-1 at 90 days
National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) score at 7 days or at early discharge
secondaryOutcomes.description: The NIHSS ranges from 0 to 42, with higher scores indicating worse outcomes.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: EuroQol Five-Dimension Five-Level Questionnaire (EQ-5D-5L) at 90 days
secondaryOutcomes.description: The EQ-5D-5L includes 5 dimensions: mobility, self-care, usual activities,pain/discomfort, and anxiety/depression. Each dimension has 5 levels: 1= no problems, 2= slight problems, 3= moderate problems, 4= severe problems, and 5= extreme problems. Higher scoresindicating worse quality of life.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of Barthel Index (BI) 95-100 at 90 days
Incidence of symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage within 24 hours
Incidence of any intracerebral hemorrhage within 24 hours
Proportion of patients with pneumonia at 7 days or at early discharge

otherOutcomes.description: The mRS ranges from 0 to 6, with higher scores indicating worse outcomes.
